title: Israel expands strikes in Lebanon and issues new evacuation warnings
summary: Israel and Hezbollah have been trading tit for tat strikes for a second day. According to a Lebanese health ministry official, 52 people have been killed and more than 150 wounded due to Israeli attacks . Thousands of civilians have been displaced, and on March 3rd the Israeli military issued dozens of new evacuation warnings for areas it said were near Hez…
